dsh-image-gen.f.activeProjectProfileHint: Select a saved visual profile (palette, style, format) to consistently apply across generations (#435).
dsh-image-gen.f.allowCustomBaseUrlHint: Explicitly permit customBaseURL or baseURL to target external hosts outside the trusted AI provider allowlist.
dsh-image-gen.f.apiKeyEnvHint: Credential reference holding the FAL API key.
dsh-image-gen.f.approvalTimeoutSecHint: Maximum time to wait for user confirmation before aborting the task (5-600 seconds).
dsh-image-gen.f.autoEnhancePromptHint: Enrich prompts with photography, lighting, and composition quality tokens.
dsh-image-gen.f.cacheByPromptHint: Reuse existing result if the prompt has already been generated.
dsh-image-gen.f.cacheBySeedHint: Reuse existing result if the exact same seed and prompt are requested.
dsh-image-gen.f.cacheTtlDaysHint: Legacy name for retention period in days.
dsh-image-gen.f.comfyTemplateHint: Pre-vetted workflow template (e.g. SDXL txt2img, img2img, InstantID face transfer, RealESRGAN upscaler).
dsh-image-gen.f.comfyWorkflowJsonHint: Custom ComfyUI API workflow graph (JSON) with {{prompt}} placeholders.
dsh-image-gen.f.customKeyEnvHint: Credential reference holding the API key for custom endpoint.
dsh-image-gen.f.customModelHint: Model name sent to custom images endpoint.
dsh-image-gen.f.customSizeHint: Fixed dimension sent to custom endpoint (e.g. 1024x1024).
dsh-image-gen.f.dailyBudgetUsdHint: Hard spending cap per day across all visual generation tools (0 = no limit).
dsh-image-gen.f.defaultFormatHint: Target file format (PNG, JPEG, or WEBP).
dsh-image-gen.f.defaultSizeHint: Aspect ratio and resolution applied when image_size is omitted.
dsh-image-gen.f.defaultStylePresetHint: Default style preset applied to generations (e.g. cinematic, anime, photorealistic).
dsh-image-gen.f.deliverAsHint: How images reach conversation: "link" (text LLM safe) or "image" (multimodal vision).
dsh-image-gen.f.diskCacheHint: Instant <50ms retrieval and zero API cost for repeated identical generations.
dsh-image-gen.f.enableLlmEnhancerHint: Legacy toggle for LLM prompt expansion.
dsh-image-gen.f.enabledHint: Enable or disable image generation tools across the workspace.
dsh-image-gen.f.enhanceBelowCharsHint: Prompts longer than this character count will skip expansion.
dsh-image-gen.f.enhanceModelHint: Dedicated LLM model used to expand prompts (empty = conversation model).
dsh-image-gen.f.enhancePromptHint: Expand concise prompts with rich artistic details before generation.
dsh-image-gen.f.fallbackProvidersHint: Comma-separated list of fallback providers to cascade to on 429, 5xx, or quota limits (e.g. replicate, custom, gemini).
dsh-image-gen.f.geminiKeyEnvHint: Credential reference holding Google Gemini API key.
dsh-image-gen.f.geminiModelHint: Google Gemini image generation model identifier.
dsh-image-gen.f.historyLimitHint: Maximum number of recent generation records kept in memory.
dsh-image-gen.f.localBaseURLHint: Server address (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8188 for ComfyUI, http://127.0.0.1:7860 for A1111).
dsh-image-gen.f.localKindHint: Select between ComfyUI API or Automatic1111 WebUI backend.
dsh-image-gen.f.localModelHint: Checkpoint name or ComfyUI workflow name.
dsh-image-gen.f.loopGuardLimitHint: Maximum consecutive image generations allowed before requiring user input (0 = off).
dsh-image-gen.f.modelHint: Target model on FAL endpoint (e.g. fal-ai/flux-2/klein/9b).
dsh-image-gen.f.outputDirHint: Directory path where generated images are saved on disk.
dsh-image-gen.f.pollIntervalMsHint: Frequency of checking task progress on asynchronous queues.
dsh-image-gen.f.providerHint: Backend service used for image generation.
dsh-image-gen.f.pruneDaysHint: Automatically delete image files and cache older than this many days (0 = keep forever).
dsh-image-gen.f.qualityGateHint: Automatically inspects generated frames and silently re-rolls blank or broken outputs.
dsh-image-gen.f.replicateKeyEnvHint: Credential reference holding the Replicate API token.
dsh-image-gen.f.requireApprovalHint: Require explicit user confirmation in chat before calling billable image generation APIs.
dsh-image-gen.f.seedreamKeyEnvHint: Credential reference holding the SeaDream API key.
dsh-image-gen.f.stylePresetHint: Automatic visual style suffix added to all generated prompts.
dsh-image-gen.f.subscriptionQualityHint: Target quality profile when using Codex or Grok subscriptions.
dsh-image-gen.f.timeoutMsHint: Maximum overall timeout before failing a generation request.
dsh-image-gen.f.toolsetCreativeHint: Enable creative tools: spritesheet, seamless_pattern, sketch_to_image, image_pack.
dsh-image-gen.f.toolsetDesignHint: Enable design tools: style_matrix, theme_pair, ui_asset, character_sheet, beautify_diagram, anchor.
dsh-image-gen.f.toolsetFrontendHint: Enable frontend tools: extract_design_tokens, image_to_css_gradient, check_image_contrast, responsive_mockups.
dsh-image-gen.f.toolsetProcessingHint: Enable processing tools: remove_background, upscale, vectorize, convert, grid, smart_crop, asset_pack, replace_image_text.
dsh-image-gen.f.toolsetProfileHint: Select which tools to register into context: minimal (<= 3 core tools, saving ~8k prompt tokens), all (30 tools), or custom.
